title: One Auditor re-check result: one JSON line in D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\auditor\audits.jsonl
description: Appended by the Auditor (roles/auditor.md) through audits.py, the one reader/writer of this schema; read by audit_prescreen and arbiter_tiers through audits.read(). The file exists and may be empty (= no audits yet): `python3 src/RimMandrake/rimflow/audits.py ensure` creates it (the Auditor's pre_launch and the wave-2 setup step). A missing file, or a line that breaks this schema, is UNMEASURED, never 'no past failures' (review AA, brief AA8).

ts.description: UTC ISO-8601 time the verdict was written

flags.description: the pre-screen's flags for the item

defect_class.description: a non-empty string when verdict is DEFECT, else null

evidence.description: absolute Windows paths the re-checker read or wrote

run.description: the Auditor run that wrote the line: its role_launch unit (env RM_ROLE_UNIT), else a run id the Auditor chose for the whole run

waiting_for.description: UNRESOLVED only: the evidence the re-check waits for (a path or a named run). Present and non-empty = a WAITING line

x-idempotency-doc: One line per item, sha and run: audits.append() refuses a second line with the same key (auditor.md 'Two records per result').

x-waiting-index.waiting: verdict UNRESOLVED with a non-empty waiting_for
x-waiting-index.settled_by: a LATER line (file order) for the same item and sha whose verdict is SOUND or DEFECT
x-waiting-index.doc: the durable waiting index (auditor.md 'Carried picks', review roles r2 #7): audits.waiting() lists every waiting line with no settling successor; a wait is never dropped

x-conditionals: defect_class is a non-empty string iff verdict is DEFECT
